identity.encode_receipt_state_at_review: complete; final-candidate3 and post-candidate3 jobs exit0, same master preflight0
identity.provenance_basis: Current exact source/master/WAV/events SHA256; ffprobe3778frames30fps125.933344s; direct RGB comparison to candidate3 native frames; packet-by-packet AAC payload hashes and PTS/DTS/duration identical to prior audited master.

method: Read the actual38-event bank selection and rendered_start_s. Reproduced each exact deterministic pitch, resampling, sustained-cue EQ, gain and pan filter in ffmpeg, in memory, without modifying source or media. Measured first minus20dB onset, absolute sample peak and5ms RMS peak separately.

Correlated each performed cue template against the finalized master WAV within a200ms search region. Ten templates with correlation>=0.3 independently recover4.943-5.057ms processing delay, consistent with the final limiter. Lower-correlation cases were not treated as individual cue verification or sync failures.

Decoded ten300ms windows from the current muxed AAC master and the finalized WAV. Correlation recovered zero additional offset at every window; correlations range0.999070-0.999970. Thus mux/AAC does not add a measured shift in these samples.

Checked ffprobe158frames for each inspected current native chunk and inspected actual consecutive30fps contact strips. Then decoded the same eight-frame ranges from the current encoded master. All ten encoded strips are byte-identical to their native counterparts; the collar comparison used full native video to cross its chunk boundary.

Native and encoded strips show hand closure, the long opening throw reaching its detent, four spring flaps, weight/socket seating, gate retraction, collar separation and final lever settle. No human listening or full-film perceptual judgment is claimed.

Candidate3: entire AAC packet payload-hash/PTS/DTS/duration/size listing matches candidate1 exactly. Prior AAC/WAV correlation and isolated cue measurements therefore apply unchanged. Decoded new master RGB for current contact and repair frames and compared directly with candidate3 native PNG RGB. This is actual encoded verification, not source math.

measured_limits.visual_precision: Frame-level contact windows only; not subframe pixel-motion metrology. The estimated discrete range stays within one30fps frame.

sustained_cue_interpretation: Whoosh peaks occur roughly177-296ms after authored movement onset while their air movement is still underway. They are not contact clicks and their maxima must not be compared with movement start as if they were impacts.

Beat20 creak has a global sample maximum140.9ms after the authored flap crossing but its5ms RMS maximum is only3.3ms later. Beat3 creak likewise has a late340.2ms individual sample maximum but its RMS maximum is0.6ms from the authored contact. An onset/absolute-maximum distinction matters here.
Paper and chain cues can peak44-211ms after their scheduled gestures. Those are sustained friction cues; this numeric audit does not establish their subjective prominence under speech.
remaining_checks: No human listening or claim of subjective cue prominence under narration. Publication and other release gates remain parent-owned.
